---
title: "3. Bare-earth DTM"
---

```{r}
library(lidR)
library(terra)

las <- readLAS("data/raw/lidar2020_test/orting_test.laz")
las
```
```{r}
dtm <- rasterize_terrain(las, res = 1, algorithm = tin())

slp <- terrain(dtm, "slope", unit = "radians")
asp <- terrain(dtm, "aspect", unit = "radians")
hs <- shade(slp, asp, angle = 45, direction = 315)

plot(hs, col = grey(0:100 / 100), legend = FALSE)
```
```{r}
ctg <- readLAScatalog("data/raw/lidar2020")
ctg
plot(ctg)
```
```{r}
opt_chunk_buffer(ctg) <- 20
dtm <- rasterize_terrain(ctg, res = 1, algorithm = tin())

corridor <- vect("data/reach/corridor.geojson") |> project(dtm)
dtm <- mask(crop(dtm, corridor), corridor)

dir.create("data/processed", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeRaster(dtm, "data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
dtm
```
```{r}
hs <- shade(terrain(dtm, "slope", unit = "radians"),
            terrain(dtm, "aspect", unit = "radians"),
            angle = 45, direction = 315)

plot(hs, col = grey(0:100 / 100), legend = FALSE)
plot(dtm, col = hcl.colors(50, "Earth"), alpha = 0.5, add = TRUE)
```
